_meta.description: Navigation Bar tokens for mobile only (Top + Bottom). Desktop variants excluded per scope. Top Nav has 3 OS variants (iOS/Android/Web) differing only in safe-area height; Bottom Nav has 2 platform variants (iOS/Android) with different paddings and label sizes.

top._description: Top navigation bar — sits at the top of mobile screens. Structure: Safe Area (status bar spacer) + Bar. The Bar has three sections: Left (icon/title/car-number), Center (optional label), Right (icon/label/button).

osVariants._description: Three OS variants differ only in Safe Area (status-bar spacer) height above the bar.

slots._description: Each optional content slot available inside the bar.

leftLabel.description: Title text on left side (alternative to leftIcon). Supports optional count badge next to it.

carNumber.description: Korean license plate style badge embedded in the Top Nav left slot. Used for car-related screens.

rightButton.description: Compact Primary pill button on the right. Smaller than the standalone Button S variant.

resource._description: Atomic building blocks used inside Top Nav layouts.

tap.description: Large tabbed title text used in segmented-title headers (e.g. '상품 | 리뷰 | 문의' row). Bold 24px. Selected draws darker gray.

selected.note: Uses primitive gray.700 (#4b4b4b) because semantic.label has no 700 entry.

title._description: Page-title block at 3 sizes — used as a top-of-screen title (often below the bar).

bottom._description: Bottom tab navigation — sits at the bottom of mobile screens. Contains 3 tabs (icon + label) + system nav bar spacer. iOS and Android differ in tab paddings and label size.

shadow._description: Top-edge soft shadow lifting the bar off the content.

tab._description: Individual tab cell — building block of Bottom Nav. Includes optional badge slot (top-right dot).

scope: Top Nav: mobile only (iOS, Android, Web OS variants). Desktop Top Nav (Size L/M/S/XS) excluded per request.
Bottom Nav: mobile only (iOS, Android platform variants). No desktop equivalent in the Figma source.
The 'Bottom Button' (757x64 Size L) in the Figma 'Bottom Navigation' section was not extracted — it's a wide CTA-bar unrelated to the tab-navigation scope of this request.
design_quirks: leftLabel uses lineHeight 1.125 (tighter than the 1.5 system default). Preserve when rendering.
rightLabel, centerLabel, and rightButton.label use non-zero letterSpacing (0.15, -0.23, -0.24) — these override the typography system's default 0.
Tap resource 'selected' color is primitive gray.700 (#4b4b4b), because semantic.label intentionally skips the 700 step. This is the only known reference to a primitive gray from the nav components.

The embedded Bottom Nav tabs in the full Bottom Navigation component use label color #333 (gray.800) for the active state, while the standalone Bottom Nav/Resource/Tab uses {label.900} (#111). The Resource values (label.900 / label.400) are the canonical tokens — treat the nav-bar aggregate as slightly stale and follow the Resource values when designing.
_notes.token_references: Values like {background.default}, {label.900}, {label.400}, {gray.700}, {brand.600}, {static.white}, {status.error} resolve against ~/design-system/colors/*.json. Font aliases (title4, title3, heading1, heading2, mobile.11.medium, mobile.12.medium) resolve against ~/design-system/typography/typography.json.
